record.question: Which of the following points has been included under the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019?
options: Reduction of approval time to 30 days for drugs manufactured in India.
Reduction of approval time to 30 days for drugs manufactured outside India.
Strict conduct of local clinical trial for drugs approved abroad
To impose regulatory fines for manufacture of drug for orphan or rare disease
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Reduction of approval time to 30 days for drugs manufactured in India.. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 10, printed Q90. The key selects option A. The printed generalized approval-time claim omits regulatory conditions; a final exam key does not replace the actual rule text.
